info.name: Delivez - Confidential Delivery (Vault) - Production
info.description:
PRODUCTION POSTMAN COLLECTION for Delivez Confidential Courier / Vault Module.

Strictly implements the unified 8-step canonical contract with zero separate APIs required across all 9 services.

Pre-configured for Production Server:
- Base URL: http://40.81.244.167:3012/api/v1 (or https://api.delivez.com/api/v1)
- Pre-loaded Credentials & Self-Contained Collection Variables: Can be imported and run immediately without an external environment file.
- Auto-Variables: Login and booking creation automatically store tokens, booking IDs, payment IDs, and receipt IDs.
- Includes 6 Folders:
  0. Schema Discovery & Form Templates (No separate APIs needed)
  1. Authentication (OTP & Password login)
  2. Create Bookings (All 9 Canonical Services: Secure, Priority, Direct, Precise, Hand Carry, Return, Exchange, Critical, MultiPoint)
  3. Booking Retrieval & Lifecycle Management
  4. Payments API
  5. Receipts API

item.name: 0. Schema Discovery & Form Templates (No Separate APIs Required)
item.description: Endpoints that return the full 8-step form template, service catalog, and API mapping so the frontend and client can dynamically render forms without needing custom endpoints for each service.

request.description: Returns the exact 8-step canonical JSON structure with all field keys, all options arrays (pickup_type_options, delivery_type_options, top_item_type_options, package_type_options, security_level_options, verification_method_options), all 9 service configurations, and service_api_mapping.

response.name: 200 OK - Complete Canonical Schema Template

request.description: Returns the list of 9 available Vault courier plans, the canonical template, and service API mapping.

response.name: 200 OK - 9 Services & Catalog

item.name: 3. Booking Retrieval & Lifecycle Management
